title: Run one real resumable raw-source-to-Projection shadow through the top-level CLI

root_cause_and_repair.root_cause: The only public Shadow command was a deliberately structural historical path. It did not start from raw source, did not persist the v3 state graph, did not compose I0/E0/S1/K1/B0/K2/B1/VEC/Projection/G0/DP, and could not prove a resume boundary or a text-only claim ceiling.
root_cause_and_repair.repair: Added the separate top-level text-shadow command. It normalizes raw source, receives only stage Drafts through the A4 structured port, locally assembles facts/IDs/hashes/ticks/bindings/VEC/Projection/Gate0/DP results, atomically accepts each A8 graph node through A2 RunSession, and rehydrates accepted nodes from immutable records without calling their provider stages again.
root_cause_and_repair.integrity_hardening: A8 stage audit records are now bound to the exact preflighted stage version, schema digest, and approved-input digest. Custom immutable run/stage/result records require no-overwrite atomic publication and fail closed when that primitive is unavailable.

checks.name: single_real_cli_entry
checks.result: python -m mode_p_vnext exposes text-shadow as the sole A8 raw-source command; the historical shadow command remains explicitly structural-only.

checks.name: unknown_script_vertical
checks.result: A temporary raw script unknown to the runtime passed through the public CLI handler using only external-port test doubles and real local composition.

checks.name: raw_source_to_fact_registry
checks.result: Raw bytes are normalized by SourceNormalizer, sent to I0 as Draft-only facts, and sealed by FactAssembler into the canonical FactRegistry envelope.

checks.name: canonical_ingest_to_projection
checks.result: The exercised graph commits I0,E0,S1,K1,B0,K2,B1,VEC,Projection,G0,DP and emits canonical VEC and ProjectionAST artifact IDs.

checks.name: accepted_nodes_not_recalled
checks.result: A paused run resumes from S1 and a completed run reopens without repeating I0/E0/S1/B0/B1 provider calls or the fresh DP call; immutable stage records and accepted ArtifactRefs are revalidated.

checks.name: no_golden_vec_injection
checks.result: The test port has no VEC, contract ID, or tick output surface. VEC is independently reconstructed from canonical B1/B0/facts and equality-checked before acceptance.

checks.name: text_validated_claim_ceiling
checks.result: All structured-call audits, run records, terminal results, and DP audits require TEXT_VALIDATED; no text path records visual acceptance.

checks.name: typed_ingest_provenance
checks.result: FactRegistry stores locally minted opaque IDs/handles and exact source-span provenance. The resulting VEC contains local ticks but no source_start/source_end timing fields.

checks.name: complete_v30_state_graph
checks.result: The A8 StateGraph has one owner per frozen output field and persistent A2 atomic node acceptance for the complete v3 text path.

checks.name: run_record_digest_tamper_rejected
checks.result: Mutating hash-bound RUN.json makes reopening fail before any provider or DP call.

checks.name: no_v4_write_or_external_media
checks.result: A8 storage rejects a v4-root target before any write; terminal records assert external_media_started=false, v4_write=false, and production_switch_authorized=false.

The DDO queue is historical read-only under v3.0, none of those paths is in A8 scope, and no such change was staged or modified.

scope_exclusions: No v4 production source, FeatureGate, production state, or production entry was modified.
No external media renderer, verifier, approval adapter, media run, frame evidence, or production switch was started.
Tests replace only external structured-text and fresh-DP ports; all normalization, assembly, persistence, VEC, Projection, Gate0, and DP canonical assembly are real local code paths.
The host lacks a native claude.exe transport, so no live external text-provider run is claimed by this Evidence.
Pre-existing tracked and untracked user workspace changes remain outside this A8 delta and were not staged.
